title: Chipperfield MuckMate 134L Electric Concrete & Cement Mixer
description_html:
The Chipperfield MuckMate is a tough, no-nonsense mixer built for the realities of the job site and the garden project alike. Whether you're laying a patio, setting fence posts, rendering a wall or pouring a base, it takes the back-breaking graft out of mixing concrete, mortar and screed.

At its heart is a 134-litre drum with a generous 100-litre working capacity, driven by a 370W double-insulated motor that runs straight off a standard 230V domestic supply — no generator, no fuss. An IP44 rating means it shrugs off the dust and splashes that come as standard on any building project.

When the mix is ready, the swivel stand and tipping mechanism let you angle and discharge the load cleanly into your barrow with minimal spillage. A sturdy chassis keeps everything stable while it turns, and large 10-inch wheels mean you can trundle it across rough ground from the van to the work face without a struggle.

Ergonomic handles with comfort grips make repositioning easy, and the machine arrives ready to plug in with a 3-metre cable and BS moulded plug. Robust enough for trade use yet straightforward enough for the weekend project, the MuckMate is the dependable mixing partner for DIY enthusiasts, landscapers and builders alike — and it's backed by a 2-year domestic warranty.

metafields.custom.bullet_two: A generous 134-litre drum and 370W motor make light work of concrete, mortar and screed for projects big and small.
metafields.custom.bullet_three: Swivel-and-tip discharge plus large 10-inch transport wheels mean less heavy lifting and easy moves around the site.
